items.verbatim: Ohio Tax Credit Authority approved a Job Creation Tax Credit of 1.249% for 7 years on 2026-04-27 for a project in the City of Strongsville, Cuyahoga County. Commitment: create 25 full-time equivalent employees generating $2,000,000 in new annual payroll at the project location.
